After the merge: the server changed, the client didn’t

# GET …/pulls/2325, after scm:merge
ETag: "seq-0.hsf.L0.ed4a2f1e1ab3f687"
number: 2325
state: closed
merged: true
mergeable_state: unknown
_forms:
  scm:comment: {…}
  scm:label: {…}
  scm:edit: {…}
# gone: scm:merge, scm:close, scm:reopen,
#       scm:request-review, scm:update-branch
# GET /unavailable/d0a0136ee8d4d2bb  (as served)
unavailable:
  - title: Close
    reason: The pull request is already closed.
  - title: Reopen
    reason: A merged pull request can't be reopened.
  - title: Merge
    reason: A closed pull request can't be merged;
            reopen it first.
  - title: Request a review
    reason: A closed pull request can't have reviews requested;
            reopen it first.
  - title: Update the branch
    reason: A closed pull request's branch isn't updated;
            reopen it first.
# each also has rel: /profiles/scm#close, #reopen, …

7 forms open, 3 merged. ARTIE needed no new code: it reads what’s offered, as a browser does.

pull.reader.yaml
say: The same pull request, read after scm:merge. The state changed, so the forms changed: three left, comment, label and edit. merge, close and reopen are gone, each with its reason. ARTIE needed no new code to know; it read what's offered. The ETag changed too, so any act still holding the old one gets 412.
